notes: M6/B13 lab ingest under burst. Two complementary measurements: (1) independent container burst - the measure tool fires presigned submissions open-loop at 3000/s for 15 s against the real lab-a:7443 over TLS (only the three configured test site keys exist in t0, so most answers are a signed 429 rate_limited; this stresses the signed-ack-under-overload path): client-observed ack p99=5.94 ms, lab-side schild_lab_ack_p99=3.67 ms, 0 timeouts, every response a signed ack. (2) the lab's own B13 harness (lab/internal/ingest TestBurstAckLatency) with 10,000 simulated clients and the scoring queue filled - burst p99=5.66 ms, queue-full p99=1.04 ms (49,989 x 503 queue_full + retry_after), saturation p99=30.64 ms, all < 50 ms, 0 failures. This second one is the component's own in-process harness, cited here because 10,000 distinct client keys and a forced-full scoring queue cannot be produced from outside the container.
